title: Pixelfed Instance Configuration
description: JSON Schema for all configurable Pixelfed options. x-env: environment variable name. x-config-cache: true when editable at runtime via the admin panel. x-sensitive: true when the value is a secret and must not be logged or displayed.

account.autofollow.description: Automatically follow a set of accounts when a new user registers.

account.autofollow_usernames.description: Comma-separated list of local usernames that new users will automatically follow.

app.banner_image.description: Path to the instance banner image shown on the landing page.

app.debug.description: Enable detailed error pages. Must be false in production.

app.description.description: A longer description of the instance.
app.description.default: Pixelfed is an image sharing platform, an ethical alternative to centralized platforms.

app.name.description: The name of your Pixelfed instance.

app.previous_keys.description: Comma-separated list of previous `APP_KEY` values, for decryption after a key rotation.

app.rules.description: JSON-encoded array of instance rules shown during registration.

app.short_description.description: A short one-line description of the instance shown on the landing page.
app.short_description.default: Pixelfed is an image sharing platform, an ethical alternative to centralized platforms.

app.url.description: The canonical HTTPS URL of this instance (no trailing slash).

captcha.active.login.description: Show captcha on the login form.

captcha.active.register.description: Show captcha on the registration form.

captcha.secret.description: hCaptcha secret key (private, used for server-side verification).

captcha.sitekey.description: hCaptcha site key (public, used in the browser widget).

captcha.triggers.login.attempts.description: Number of failed login attempts that trigger the captcha.

captcha.triggers.login.enabled.description: Automatically show captcha on login after N failed attempts.

cors.allowed_origins.description: Comma-separated origins that can make cross-origin requests. Each origin can use a wildcard, as `*.example.org` does.

costar.actor.block.description: Comma-separated remote actor URIs to block. Content from these actors is rejected.

costar.actor.cw.description: Comma-separated remote actor URIs whose content gets a content warning.

costar.actor.unlisted.description: Comma-separated remote actor URIs whose content is removed from public timelines.

costar.domain.block.description: Comma-separated domains to block. Content from these domains is rejected.

costar.domain.cw.description: Comma-separated domains whose content gets a content warning.

costar.domain.unlisted.description: Comma-separated domains whose content is removed from public timelines.

costar.keyword.block.description: Comma-separated keywords to block. Content with these keywords is rejected.

costar.keyword.cw.description: Comma-separated keywords that give content a content warning.

costar.keyword.unlisted.description: Comma-separated keywords that remove content from public timelines.

federation.activitypub.authorized_fetch.description: Require HTTP Signatures on all incoming ActivityPub fetch requests (ghost mode).

federation.activitypub.delivery.concurre.description: Number of concurrent ActivityPub delivery workers.

federation.activitypub.delivery.timeout.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for ActivityPub delivery requests.

federation.activitypub.enabled.description: Enable ActivityPub federation with other Fediverse instances.

federation.activitypub.remoteFollow.description: Enable the remote-follow / interact dialog for federated users.

federation.custom_emoji.enabled.description: Enable support for custom emoji from remote instances.

federation.migration.description: Allow users to migrate their account to/from other ActivityPub instances.

filesystems.cloud.description: Which cloud filesystem driver to use when cloud storage is enabled.

filesystems.disks.s3.endpoint.description: Custom S3-compatible API endpoint (e.g. for MinIO or Backblaze B2).

filesystems.disks.s3.url.description: Custom public URL prefix for S3 objects (CDN or path rewrite).

filesystems.disks.s3.use_path_style_endp.description: Use path-style S3 URLs instead of subdomain-style (required for MinIO).

filesystems.disks.spaces.url.description: Public CDN URL prefix for DigitalOcean Spaces objects.

filesystems.disks.spaces.use_path_style_.description: Use path-style URLs for DigitalOcean Spaces.

filesystems.disks.spaces.visibility.description: Default object visibility for DigitalOcean Spaces.

instance.admin.pid.description: Profile ID of the primary admin account shown on the landing page.

instance.avatar.local_to_cloud.description: Store local user avatars on cloud/S3 storage.

instance.banner.blurhash.description: BlurHash placeholder string for the instance banner image.

instance.curated_registration.captcha_en.description: Require captcha during curated registration flow.

instance.curated_registration.enabled.description: Enable curated (filtered) registration: users apply and admins approve.

instance.curated_registration.resend_con.description: Maximum times an applicant may resend their confirmation email.

instance.discover.public.description: Make the Discover page publicly accessible to logged-out visitors.

instance.email.description: Public contact email address shown in the instance metadata.

instance.embed.post.description: Allow individual posts to be embedded in external sites.

instance.embed.profile.description: Allow profile pages to be embedded in external sites.

instance.has_legal_notice.description: Display a legal notice link in the footer.

instance.landing.show_directory.description: Show the user directory section on the landing page.

instance.landing.show_explore.description: Show the explore/trending section on the landing page.

instance.notifications.nag.api_key.description: API key for the Pixelfed push gateway.

instance.oauth.refresh_expiration.description: OAuth refresh token lifetime in days.

instance.oauth.token_expiration.description: OAuth access token lifetime in days.

instance.page.404.body.default: The link you followed may be broken, or the page may have been removed. Go back to Pixelfed.

instance.page.503.body.default: Our service is in maintenance mode, please try again later.

instance.reports.email.enabled.description: Send email notifications to admins when a new report is filed.

instance.reports.email.to.description: Comma-separated email addresses that receive report notifications.

instance.restricted.enabled.description: Run as a restricted (private) instance where content is not publicly visible.

instance.show_peers.description: Expose the list of federated peer instances via the API.

instance.stats.total_local_posts.description: Cached count of total local posts (managed internally).

instance.timeline.local.is_public.description: Make the local timeline publicly accessible to logged-out visitors.

instance.user_filters.max_domain_blocks.description: Maximum number of domains a user can block.

instance.user_filters.max_user_blocks.description: Maximum number of accounts a user can block.

instance.user_filters.max_user_mutes.description: Maximum number of accounts a user can mute.

instance.username.remote.format.description: How to show the domain of a remote account: `@` for `@user@domain`, `from` for `user from domain`, or `custom` for the format of the theme.

logging.channels.stack.channels.description: Comma-separated log channels that the `stack` channel writes to.

media.delete_local_after_cloud.description: Delete local copies of media files after successfully uploading them to cloud storage.

media.hls.enabled.description: Enable HLS streaming support for videos (requires FFmpeg).

media.hls.p2p.description: Enable WebTorrent P2P video delivery (requires HLS).

pixelfed.allow_app_registration.description: Allow third-party apps to register OAuth clients via the API.

pixelfed.app_registration_confirm_rate_l.description: Maximum confirmation attempts before rate-limiting kicks in.
Rate-limit decay window for app registration confirmations, in seconds.

pixelfed.app_registration_rate_limit_att.description: Maximum app-registration attempts before rate-limiting kicks in.

pixelfed.app_registration_rate_limit_dec.description: Rate-limit decay window for app registrations, in seconds.

pixelfed.bouncer.enabled.description: Enable the Bouncer spam/abuse detection system.

pixelfed.cloud_storage.description: Store uploaded media on cloud/S3-compatible object storage instead of locally.

pixelfed.enforce_email_verification.description: Require new users to verify their email address before using the site.

pixelfed.enforce_max_users.description: Stop accepting registrations once the user limit is reached.

pixelfed.image_quality.description: JPEG/WebP compression quality applied when optimizing images (1-100).

pixelfed.import.instagram.enabled.description: Allow users to import their Instagram archive.

pixelfed.max_album_length.description: Maximum number of photos allowed in a single album post.

pixelfed.max_altext_length.description: Maximum character length for image alt text.

pixelfed.max_avatar_size.description: Maximum allowed size for a profile avatar upload, in kilobytes.

pixelfed.max_bio_length.description: Maximum character length for user profile bios.

pixelfed.max_caption_length.description: Maximum character length for post captions.

pixelfed.max_collection_length.description: Maximum number of posts in a user collection.

pixelfed.max_name_length.description: Maximum character length for display names.

pixelfed.max_photo_size.description: Maximum allowed size for a single photo upload, in kilobytes.

pixelfed.max_users.description: Maximum number of local user accounts allowed on this instance.

pixelfed.media_types.description: Comma-separated list of allowed upload MIME types.

pixelfed.memory_limit.description: PHP memory_limit used exclusively during image processing jobs.

pixelfed.min_password_length.description: Minimum character length for user passwords.

pixelfed.open_registration.description: Allow new users to register an account.

pixelfed.optimize_image.description: Resize and compress image uploads on ingest.

pixelfed.optimize_video.description: Transcode and optimize video uploads on ingest.

pulse.recorders.Laravel\\Pulse\\Recorder.description: Colon-separated directories that the server recorder measures the disk use of.

purify.configs.default.HTML.Allowed.description: Restrict the HTML tags that are allowed in remote content.

sanctum.stateful.description: Comma-separated domains that get stateful API authentication cookies.

uikit.custom.css.description: Custom CSS injected into every page.

uikit.custom.js.description: Custom JavaScript injected into every page.

uikit.show_custom.css.description: Enable injection of the custom CSS snippet.

uikit.show_custom.js.description: Enable injection of the custom JavaScript snippet.
